title: Reproducibility package for When Is Pooled Return-Quality Information Sufficient for Remanufacturing Capacity Choice?
description: Exact verification software and archived outputs supporting the named theoretical manuscript. Includes exchange, finite-menu and ordered residual-capacity checks, portable scripts and immutable regression inputs. Analytical proofs are in the manuscript/supplement; computations provide falsification and implementation assurance, not industrial validation or prevalence evidence. Software: MIT; documentation and archived outputs: CC BY 4.0. No DOI or publication date has yet been assigned to this release.
